name: Three Crowns - WhatsApp GREEN API AI Administrator

parameters.jsCode: const envelope=$json; const b=envelope.body??envelope; const expected=String($env.GREEN_API_WEBHOOK_SECRET||''); const provided=String(envelope.query?.token||''); const webhookOk=expected.length>=24 && provided===expected; const type=b.typeWebhook||''; const md=b.messageData||{}; const sd=b.senderData||{}; const text=md?.textMessageData?.textMessage || md?.extendedTextMessageData?.text || md?.quotedMessage?.textMessage || ''; const chatId=sd.chatId || sd.sender || ''; const idMessage=b.idMessage || ''; const phoneDigits=String(chatId).split('@')[0].replace(/\D/g,''); const phone=phoneDigits ? '+'+phoneDigits : ''; const isGuestText=webhookOk && type==='incomingMessageReceived' && Boolean(chatId) && Boolean(String(text).trim()); return [{json:{webhook_ok:webhookOk,is_guest_text:isGuestText,chat_id:String(chatId),phone,message_id:String(idMessage),sender_name:String(sd.senderName||sd.senderContactName||'').trim(),text:String(text).trim()}}];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_WHATSAPP_MODEL || $env.OPENAI_SALES_MODEL, input: `Extract booking-search facts from this guest WhatsApp message for Three Crowns Resort. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: intent (AVAILABILITY|HOTEL_QUESTION|BOOKING_INTENT|MANAGER|OTHER), check_in (YYYY-MM-DD|null), check_out (YYYY-MM-DD|null), adults (integer|null), children (integer|null), room_type_code (string|null), guest_name (string|null, only if explicitly stated by the guest), language (ru|kg|en), summary (short string). Current hotel timezone is Asia/Bishkek. Never invent missing values. Message: ${$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json.text}` }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const p=$json; let text=p.output_text; if(!text && Array.isArray(p.output)){ const parts=[]; for(const i of p.output){ for(const c of (i.content||[])){ if(c.type==='output_text'&&c.text) parts.push(c.text); } } text=parts.join('\n'); } if(!text) throw new Error('OpenAI intent extractor returned no text'); text=String(text).trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); const intent=JSON.parse(text); const complete=Boolean(intent.check_in&&intent.check_out&&Number.isInteger(Number(intent.adults))&&Number(intent.adults)>0); const src=$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json; const guestName=String(intent.guest_name||src.sender_name||'').trim(); return [{json:{...src,intent,guest_name:guestName,complete_search:complete}}];

const facts=$('Get Verified Hotel Facts').item.json; const parsed=$('Parse Intent').item.json; const availability=$json; const options=(availability.results||[]).filter(x=>x.pricing?.sellable===true&&Number.isFinite(x.pricing?.total_kgs)).slice(0,8).map(x=>({room_type_code:x.room_type_code,room_type_name:x.room_type_name,area:x.area,available_count:x.available_count,total_kgs:x.pricing.total_kgs,nights:availability.nights})); const ctx={hotel_facts:facts,current_availability:{check_in:availability.check_in,check_out:availability.check_out,nights:availability.nights,adults:availability.adults,children:availability.children,options},reservation_request:null}; const shouldCreate=parsed.intent.intent==='BOOKING_INTENT' && options.length>0 && parsed.complete_search && parsed.guest_name.length>=2 && parsed.phone.length>=5 && Boolean(parsed.message_id); return [{json:{...parsed,verified_context:ctx,should_create_request:shouldCreate}}];
const facts=$('Get Verified Hotel Facts').item.json; return [{json:{...$json,verified_context:{hotel_facts:facts,current_availability:null,reservation_request:null},should_create_request:false}}];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ idempotency_key: 'whatsapp-green:' + $json.message_id, channel: 'WHATSAPP_GREEN', guest_name: $json.guest_name, phone: $json.phone, email: null, check_in: $json.intent.check_in, check_out: $json.intent.check_out, adults: Number($json.intent.adults), children: Number($json.intent.children || 0), room_type_code: $json.intent.room_type_code || null, notes: `WhatsApp AI hot lead. ${$json.intent.summary || ''} Original: ${$json.text}`.slice(0,3900), external_message_id: $json.message_id }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const source=$('Build Availability Context').item.json; const result=$json; const ctx={...source.verified_context,reservation_request:{id:result.id||result.resultResourceId||null,is_reservation:false,idempotent_replay:Boolean(result.idempotent_replay)}}; return [{json:{...source,verified_context:ctx}}];

const p=$json; let text=p.output_text; if(!text&&Array.isArray(p.output)){const parts=[];for(const i of p.output){for(const c of(i.content||[])){if(c.type==='output_text'&&c.text)parts.push(c.text)}}text=parts.join('\n')} if(!text) throw new Error('OpenAI reply composer returned no text'); return [{json:{chat_id:$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json.chat_id,message_id:$('Normalize GREEN Event').item.json.message_id,reply:String(text).trim().slice(0,12000)}}];
